SCENE sc_001 0-21500 INT. ESTATE CHAMBERS – NIGHT
EP47:E1 0-1800 CAMERA: Low-angle focus on a dripping candle burning on a wooden table beside a dark window looking out into the misty night.
EP47:E2 1800-8500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Catherine in a lace nightgown and lilac robe, holding a goblet of red wine with cold determination.
EP47:E3 1800-8200 CATHERINE [Calculated, Defiant]: "Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate."
EP47:E4 8500-14800 CAMERA: Two-shot framing Catherine in the background with a muscular, bare-chested conspirator standing in shadow beside her.
EP47:E5 8800-14500 CONSPIRATOR [Low, Warning]: "Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry."
EP47:E6 14800-18300 CAMERA: Close-up profile of Catherine leaning close to the man's shoulder, her eyes burning with ambition.
EP47:E7 15000-18200 CATHERINE [Commanding, Scheming]: "Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls."
EP47:E8 18300-21500 CAMERA: Silhouette shot against the tall arched window as Catherine turns her back to him.
EP47:E9 18500-21200 CATHERINE [Ruthless, Focused]: "Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest."
SCENE sc_002 21500-55500 INT. DUKE'S BEDCHAMBER – MORNING
EP47:E10 21500-23200 CAMERA: Atmospheric wide pan across the spacious master bedroom, daylight spilling softly through tall Gothic windows onto the hearth fire.
EP47:E11 23200-26500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander and Juliana sitting together on the edge of the velvet bed, dressed in morning robes.
EP47:E12 23400-26800 JULIANA [Anxious, Trembling]: "What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?"
EP47:E13 26500-30500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's distressed face, tears shimmering in her eyes as she looks up at Alexander.
EP47:E14 27000-30300 JULIANA [Vulnerable, Fearful]: "What if they strip your title? Because of me?"
EP47:E15 30500-35000 ACTION: Juliana looks down at her hands, turning over her scarred palms shaped by years of herbal work.
EP47:E16 31000-35200 JULIANA [Despairing]: "I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me."
EP47:E17 35500-37500 CAMERA: Profile shot as Alexander reaches out and firmly clasps Juliana's trembling hands in his own.
EP47:E18 35800-37800 ALEXANDER [Gentle, Resolute]: "Look at me, Juliana."
EP47:E19 37500-42500 CAMERA: Close-up of Alexander raising his scarred hand to tenderly cradle Juliana's cheek.
EP47:E20 38200-42500 ALEXANDER [Fierce, Loving]: "You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing."
EP47:E21 42500-45800 CAMERA: Tight close-up on Alexander's gaze locking onto Juliana's tearful eyes.
EP47:E22 43000-45500 ALEXANDER [Deep, Unwavering]: "You are my wife."
EP47:E23 45500-48000 ACTION: Alexander gently pulls Juliana closer, his hands resting securely on her shoulders.
EP47:E24 45800-54800 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Steadfast]: "You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that."
SCENE sc_003 55500-83500 EXT. ASHBOURNE COURTYARD – DAY
EP47:E25 55500-56800 CAMERA: Wide establishing shot of the rain-drenched cobblestone courtyard surrounded by imposing Gothic arches.
EP47:E26 56800-60000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Ashbourne leaning heavily on her walking cane, glaring down at Catherine who kneels in the mud.
EP47:E27 56800-59800 LADY ASHBOURNE [Sharp, Contemptuous]: "You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?"
EP47:E28 60000-63500 CAMERA: High-angle shot looking down at Catherine in her disheveled burgundy gown, clutching her skirts and weeping profusely.
EP47:E29 60500-63400 CATHERINE [Desperate, Weeping]: "I have nowhere to go, Your Grace."
EP47:E30 63500-67000 CAMERA: Low-angle shot tracking Catherine clutching her chest in agony.
EP47:E31 63500-66800 CATHERINE [Sobbing, Pleading]: "London closed its doors! My family disowned me!"
EP47:E32 67000-71500 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Ashbourne, her gloved hand resting on her cane as she delivers her cold judgment.
EP47:E33 67200-71200 LADY ASHBOURNE [Cold, Unforgiving]: "She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road."
EP47:E34 71500-74800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Vaughn drawing his baton, ready to seize Catherine from behind.
EP47:E35 71800-74800 VAUGHN [Gruff, Ready]: "One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates."
EP47:E36 74800-78800 CAMERA: Wide shot as Alexander strides purposefully into the courtyard alongside Juliana, his coat billowing behind him.
EP47:E37 75200-78500 ALEXANDER [Furious, Decisive]: "Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!"
EP47:E38 78800-81800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine collapsed on the wet stones, looking up with tear-streaked panic.
EP47:E39 78800-81800 CATHERINE [Hysterical, Screaming]: "Please, Alexander! Have mercy!"
EP47:E40 81800-83500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana raising her right hand firmly to halt the guard.
EP47:E41 82200-83400 JULIANA [Clear, Authoritative]: "Stop."
SCENE sc_004 83500-134000 INT. ASHBOURNE GREAT HALL / VESTIBULE – CONTINUOUS
EP47:E42 83500-86500 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander turning toward Juliana in sheer disbelief.
EP47:E43 84000-86500 ALEXANDER [Indignant, Protective]: "Juliana, she tried to destroy you!"
EP47:E44 86500-88000 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana maintaining serene poise.
EP47:E45 86700-87800 JULIANA [Calm, Composed]: "She did."
EP47:E46 88000-91000 CAMERA: Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps gracefully past Alexander toward Catherine.
EP47:E47 88200-91000 JULIANA [Dignified, Principled]: "But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud."
EP47:E48 91000-95000 ACTION: Juliana walks to a side bench, picks up a rough servant's apron and a heavy iron ring of keys, and turns back to face Catherine.
EP47:E49 91500-95000 JULIANA [Steely, Direct]: "If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it."
EP47:E50 95500-98800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's face turning from despair to offended shock.
EP47:E51 96000-98800 CATHERINE [Incredulous, Stunned]: "You want me? As a guest?"
EP47:E52 98800-101200 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana staring straight into Catherine's eyes without blinking.
EP47:E53 99200-101000 JULIANA [Unflinching, Firm]: "As a scullery maid."
EP47:E54 101200-104800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Catherine recoiling in disgust, looking around at the gathered estate retainers.
EP47:E55 101500-104500 CATHERINE [Outraged, Venomous]: "You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?"
EP47:E56 104800-108500 CAMERA: Dramatic profile two-shot of Juliana standing inches away from Catherine, dominating the confrontation.
EP47:E57 105200-108500 JULIANA [Measured, Commanding]: "You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor."
EP47:E58 108500-111500 CAMERA: Juliana extends the ring of iron keys outward in her fist.
EP47:E59 108800-111500 JULIANA [Stern, Demanding]: "You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn."
EP47:E60 111500-114500 CAMERA: Close profile two-shot of the two women locked in an intense psychological battle.
EP47:E61 111800-114500 JULIANA [Unforgiving]: "You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight."
EP47:E62 114500-118500 CAMERA: Juliana presents the rough hemp apron and heavy keys right to Catherine's face.
EP47:E63 114800-118500 JULIANA [Stern, Final]: "One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing."
EP47:E64 118500-121800 CAMERA: Close-up of Catherine's trembling lips, humiliated tears spilling down her heavily made-up cheeks.
EP47:E65 119200-121600 CATHERINE [Choked, Humiliated]: "You humiliate me."
EP47:E66 121800-127500 CAMERA: Medium shot of both women standing beneath the cathedral vaulting of the hall.
EP47:E67 122200-127200 JULIANA [Calm, Sovereign]: "I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county."
EP47:E68 127500-131500 CAMERA: Extreme close-up on Catherine's trembling hands as she reaches out, taking the coarse apron and clattering iron keys, pressing them desperately against her chest.
EP47:E69 128500-131200 CATHERINE [Broken, Defeated]: "I accept, Your Grace."
EP47:E70 131500-134000 CAMERA: Wide shot down the vaulted stone hall as Catherine prostrates herself entirely upon the floor before Alexander, Juliana, and Lady Ashbourne, humbled to the stone as the scene cuts to black.
